description: D3 connects data to page elements. It can choose positions, colours and labels to make a chart. Learn a few SVG shapes, then connect a small list of numbers to a bar chart you can explain. Use a browser project with D3 7 installed. These module examples append an SVG to the page. Run one example at a time with a bundler; the plain playground does not include D3.
versionNote: Uses D3 7 selections, joins, scales, axes and SVG shape generators.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to add a fourth number and adjust the available space
Learn to change the middle value and predict its height
Learn to explain which input creates half of the circle
learningObjectives: Learn to add a fourth number and adjust the available space
Learn to change the middle value and predict its height
Learn to explain which input creates half of the circle
